Retaining Walls in the Blue Mountains

Timber, block and stone retaining walls engineered for the sloping sites that make up so much of the Blue Mountains.

A lot of Mountains blocks are steep, and a good retaining wall turns unusable slope into flat, usable garden. Done wrong, walls fail — so we build them properly, with the right footings, drainage and materials.

Whether it's a low garden wall or a structural wall to create a level yard, we design and build to suit the ground and the load.

What’s included

  • Timber sleeper walls
  • Concrete block and besser walls
  • Sandstone and stone walls
  • Engineered footings and drainage
  • Agi-drain and backfill done right
  • Advice on height and approvals
